content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description Sonar is looking for a VP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role, responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to translate customer needs and market trends into design decisions that drive measurable business impact.

Position description We are looking for a Web Producer to help us continue building and running a best in class content production and publication engine. As a Web Producer at Sonar, you will be pivotal in maintaining and optimizing our digital presence to drive engagement with our target audience. You will oversee the corporate website, building, editing, maintaining, and launching pages, and you will help shape how we prioritize the web roadmap alongside Stefan and the broader GTM team. You will be a critical stakeholder connecting Product, Marketing, MarTech, Mission Control, and Sales. What you will do Manage the day to day operations of the company website, including content updates and feature enhancements, and help inform the direction of the web roadmap based on what you're seeing in performance and requests. Collaborate with cross functional teams, including marketing, design, and product, to align website initiatives with business objectives and brand guidelines. Position description Sonar's website is becoming a bigger driver of pipeline as our Web team scales, and we need someone focused full-time on turning traffic into qualified demand. As Website Conversion & Optimization Manager, you own the site's CRO and testing program end to end: hypotheses, test design, QA, launch, and analysis, plus the broader analytics and organic and content signals that feed it, working directly with our VP, Digital & Web. This is a hands-on role: with no dedicated testing team under you, you'll run experiments yourself as often as you'll direct them, partnering with our SEO Strategist, Lead Web Producer, and engineering team to keep every page fast, findable, and built to convert, and directing outside optimization and testing agency partners rather than building or managing an internal team. What you will do Own conversion rate optimization across landing pages, calls-to-action, form flows, and on-site conversational engagement (Qualified), from hypothesis through shipped change.
